sections.content: You know reported statements from B1 Unit 25 (*estilo indirecto*) and the *pluscuamperfecto* from B1 Unit 1. This lesson adds more reporting verbs, *contar*, *explicar*, *informar* and *asegurar*, each followed by *que* and a verb that has moved back one step.

items.spanish: Él me dijo que no tenía tiempo.
items.english: He told me that he did not have time.
She explained that she lived there.

items.spanish: La mujer afirmó que había oído un ruido extraño.
items.english: The woman stated that she had heard a strange noise.

sections.content: The reporting verb adds a flavour: *afirmar* and *asegurar* sound firmer and more formal than plain *decir*, as in *La mujer afirmó que había oído un ruido extraño*.
